cand.title: EPFL Engineering Industry Day 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong engineering fit but downgraded for Lausanne travel uncertainty and one-day format.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named 2027 accommodation buyer or contracting authority was verified. Two verified institutional referral candidates: Pascale Van Landuyt, Key Account Manager, Industry Liaison Office; Frédéric Claude Denis Dreyer, Industry Liaison Officer and Innovation & Ecosystem Manager, Deanship ENAC. Their published partnership/event responsibilities make introductions plausible, but neither is verified as this event’s organizer or hotel buyer. Historical direct event contact: Sebastian Gautsch, named on the 2019 event listing; current responsibility unverified. Primary routing remains industryday@epfl.ch.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 27 April 2027, a single-day event at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland, within the requested horizon. Official wording: “The EPFL Engineering Industry Day returns on April 27, 2027.” Programme and registration details “will be announced soon.” No 2028 edition announcement was located. This is an activity date, not a publication date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: weak immediate fit. This is a Lausanne-campus industry networking day, not a residential retreat or resort programme. No event-specific evidence was found that delegates arrive via Geneva Airport or lodge toward Nyon, La Côte or Geneva: no travel evidence. Generic airport accessibility does not qualify this lead. YOTEL’s supplied 237 rooms and roughly 250-theatre meeting limit do not make it an alternative main venue for an event reporting over 800 participants in 2026. A separately evidenced small corporate delegation, speaker stay or satellite workshop could fit, but no such demand is published. Do not assume catering capacity or a full-house booking.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 campus commitment: EPFL, Lausanne. The event access page names SwissTech Convention Center, at the EPFL metro stop. Exact venue address: SwissTech Convention Center, Quartier Nord EPFL, Route Louis-Favre 2, 1024 Ecublens, Switzerland; Lausanne area, canton Vaud, NOT Founex/Nyon/La Côte/Geneva Airport corridor or Geneva city. Important limitation: the access page is undated; the 2027 save-the-date does not independently name SwissTech or a room. Treat SwissTech as the published series venue, not evidence of a signed 2027 venue contract.
findings.historicalRotation: The official archive lists 2016, 2017, 2019, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. SwissTech Convention Center is verified for 2016, 2019 and 2023–2026; no destination rotation is established. Recent consecutive editions and a confirmed 2027 return establish recurrence, not a guaranteed annual schedule through 2028. A separate 25 March 2020 listing is an announced edition, not proof it took place. The 2026 archive mistakenly calls 3 March 2026 Thursday; other EPFL evidence identifies the same numeric date and Tuesday. Preserve 2026-03-03, not the erroneous weekday.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, room block, open hotel RFP, room-night total or peak-room figure was found in reviewed English/French event sources. The access page says “We strongly encourage you to use public transportation” and identifies SwissTech at metro stop EPFL; it does not publish housing instructions. The registration page invites 2027 enquiries at industryday@epfl.ch. No event-committed hotels can be named. Generic campus information lists EVERY hotel on that page: SwissTech Hotel and Starling Hotel. The convention centre separately promotes SwissTech Hotel, 65 rooms, a few steps away; neither page establishes an Industry Day booking commitment.
findings.organizationStructure: University/institution-led programme, not an association event, corporate-owned conference, PCO or DMC. EPFL’s 2025 School of Engineering annual report attributes the 2025 event to the School and Vice Presidency for Innovation, and states the 2026 edition becomes “an EPFL-wide event organized by the Vice Presidency for Innovation, with the support of all EPFL schools.” No external accommodation intermediary or PCO was identified; the 2027 individual purchasing structure remains unpublished.
findings.competitiveLimitations: SwissTech is the established event setting, and nearby campus hotels have a geographic advantage (inference). Generic venue/campus sources name SwissTech Hotel and Starling Hotel, but no event-specific incumbent lodging contract was verified. 2026 registration being “fully booked” means event admission, NOT sold-out hotels or overflow. No sourced hotel compression, rejected room demand, overflow instruction or competitor capacity shortfall supports a YOTEL overflow pitch.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a single qualification enquiry to industryday@epfl.ch identifying YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex: ask for the 2027 logistics/accommodation decision-maker, dated SwissTech confirmation, whether speakers or external corporate delegations need overnight rooms, whether housing is centrally contracted, and whether any delegates actually choose Geneva Airport/La Côte lodging. Request an introduction via Pascale Van Landuyt or Frédéric Dreyer only as institutional referrals. Do not quote a speculative block; proceed with a small tailored offer only after travel and demand evidence. Otherwise retain as low-priority relationship development, subject to ORS qualification/publication gates.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 event is announced, but registration/programme are not yet published; accommodation access is unconfirmed, not open. The registration page’s “2026 is now fully booked” is historical and must not be applied to 2027. Published commercial contact: industryday@epfl.ch, with company identification requested for 2027 updates. Do not position YOTEL as official housing.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development thesis only: seek a separately sourced small delegation or off-campus industry workshop if the organizer verifies overnight demand and explicit willingness to stay toward La Côte/Geneva Airport. Do not pitch relocation of the full campus event or assume venue rotation. No 2028 dates, open hotel procurement or future room block is established.
